metadata.title: Primary-source reconciliation of BC Place, BCEC and PavCo

conventions.scope: Distinct statutory, registry, operational and business-name milestones; no inferred corporate continuation from an asset transfer.

events.title: Former B.C. Pavilion Corporation incorporated under the Company Act
events.interpretation_notes: This dates the former PavCo. The present corporation’s 1 April 2008 amalgamation with Vancouver Convention Centre Expansion Project Ltd. remains a separate event; BCEC was not a former name of PavCo.

events.title: British Columbia Place Ltd. statutorily renamed British Columbia Enterprise Corporation

evidence.source_title: British Columbia Enterprise Corporation Act, consolidation current to 25 November 1993
evidence.locator: Section 1.1 and historical note: 1987-44-2, effective 31 March 1987 (B.C. Reg. 299/87)

events.interpretation_notes: The statute identifies the continuing company by incorporation certificate 207097. The registry’s 20 August 1987 name-effective entry is kept separately and is not substituted for this statutory effective date.

events.title: B.C. Pavilion Corporation registers PavCo as a business name
events.interpretation_notes: Registration under the Partnership Act is a business-name milestone, not the corporation’s incorporation or an asset transfer.

events.title: BCEC dissolved when the B.C. Pavilion Corporation Act comes into force

evidence.source_title: B.C. Gazette, Part II: B.C. Reg. 71/2023 (OIC 171/2023)
evidence.locator: Deposited and approved 13 March 2023; operative paragraph (a)

events.interpretation_notes: The regulation commences the whole B.C. Pavilion Corporation Act, SBC 2022 c. 33. Section 4 dissolves BCEC; sections 5 and 6 transfer its remaining assets and liabilities to the government. Royal assent on 3 November 2022 and the registry status entry dated 27 March 2023 are separate dates. The statute is https://www.bclaws.gov.bc.ca/civix/document/id/complete/statreg/22033 .
